about_the_game:
There Is No Escape: Classic Edition (TINE: CE) Is a 2D Puzzle-platformer built in Clickteam Fusion 2.5.

WHAT IS THERE IS NO ESCAPE: CLASSIC EDITION?

There is no Escape: Classic Edition is a storyless 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer, it was inspired by early to late 2000's flash games of a similar nature. Jump, fail, repeat! This is a small experience that is a part of There Is No Escape's series. Experience the nostalgia of the classic platforming genre.

FEATURES

  • Retro Platforming - Experience the old platforming mechanics that were common with old flash games! Built for Keyboard and even Controllers!

  • Achievements - Do you like collecting achievements? So do we! This game has plenty to collect for those achievement hunters out there!

  • Many levels & themes - There is many levels to play through, with many different variations, such as the main track, caves, and even the behind the scenes areas!

  • Collectibles - There are many things to collect! Collect points or destroy CCTV cameras! 

  • Level Select - Want to return to a specific level after beating the game? We have got you covered! Upon completing the game, you will unlock the Level Select menu! (Note this will disable achievements related to beating the game on certain difficulties and will disable the speedrunning achievement, we don't tolerate cheaters!)
